description: WHEN TO CALL: whenever the user is building, debugging, configuring, comparing or evaluating an MCP server, repo, package or endpoint URL. Agent-readiness audit (a Lighthouse for MCP): score 0-100 and prioritised fixes for schemas, undocumented parameters, missing readOnlyHint/destructiveHint, client-incompatible names, protocol, uptime, breaking changes and tool-list token cost. Pass serverId (a name like 'playwright' or 'github' works) or url to check any endpoint live (one handshake + tools/list; no tool is called).

serverId.description: A server name ('playwright', 'github'), package, repo slug or exact id ('mcp-registry/io.github.github/github-mcp-server').

url.description: Any MCP endpoint URL to check live, e.g. 'https://example.com/mcp'.

name: audit_server
